items.title: Teenager’s hand blown off as French school protests enter 3rd week
items.excerpt: Rights groups accuse police in France ​of using heavy-handed tactics against minors, including batons, tear gas and flash-ball guns.

items.title: OpenAI rogue agent possibly behind Wikipedia disruption in May, operator says
items.excerpt: Wikimedia also said that the OpenAI agents made unauthorized edits to Wikimedia wiki sites, including "potentially malicious edits" to a citation tool.

items.title: Food prices may rise soon as diesel ‘shock’ bleeds through economy: report
items.excerpt: Canadians could wind up with a bigger grocery bill in the coming months as a major price "shock" for diesel and crude oil works its way through supply chains, Scotiabank says.

items.title: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor files legal action over arrest by U.K. police
items.excerpt: The former prince, Andrew, was arrested on suspicion of misconduct in public office in February. His former home was searched at the same time.

items.title: Nobel prize in medicine goes to U.S., German scientists for brain research
items.excerpt: The Nobel Assembly of Sweden's Karolinska Institute said the trio of scientists had been selected for their "discoveries concerning light-gated ion channels and optogenetics."

items.title: Middle East oil exports reportedly topped pre-war levels last month: data
items.excerpt: Persian Gulf oil exporters topped pre-war levels for about half of September, shipping data showed on Monday, though attacks on tankers continue to cloud the outlook.

items.title: ‘No risk for Canada’ as Russian lab worker dies of ‘unknown’ illness: minister
items.excerpt: Russian authorities said the situation was under control and that all known contacts of the dead woman had been identified, examined and placed under medical supervision.

items.title: Cornell president calls alleged gang rape ‘deeply disturbing,’ pledges greater transparency
items.excerpt: Cornell's president pledged greater transparency amid mounting outrage over the school's handling of the case, calling the alleged gang rape "deeply disturbing."

items.title: Axe-wielding FlyDubai co-pilot had been flagged over extremism concerns
items.excerpt: The co-pilot accused of attacking the captain on an Israel-bound flight with an axe had been barred from flying on his country's airline because of concerns about extremist views.

items.title: Dual UK-Iranian national released on bail over suspected plot against US-run military base
items.excerpt: A dual U.K.-Iranian national arrested on suspicion of plotting a terror attack following a security incident at a U.S.-run military air base in England has been released on bail.
